语阅隐私说明Yuyue Privacy Policy

生效日期：2026 年 11 月 22 日 Effective: November 22, 2026

一句话 数据存在哪 什么时候联网 Key 和密码 在设备上完成的 保存和删除 联系

一句话

语阅是一款免费的读书、听书软件，没有自己的服务器，不收集、不保存、不出售、不分享任何关于你的数据。没有账号、没有统计、没有追踪、没有广告。

数据存在哪

书、进度、划线、想法、生词、播客和设置都存在你自己的设备上。打开同步时，它们只在你的设备和你自己选的网盘（iCloud 云盘或 WebDAV，Google Drive 即将支持）之间传，开发者收不到，也看不到。

什么时候联网

只在你自己设置或主动触发下面这些的时候：

  • 同步：连你选的网盘。
  • 远程书库与播客订阅：直接连你添加的 OPDS / WebDAV 书库，或拉取你订阅的播客 RSS 与单集音频。
  • 书伴与书房电台：填了自己的云端 Key 时，你的提问、相关摘录与原文片段直接发给你选的服务商；没填云端 Key 时使用设备端侧模型或你自己的本机 / 局域网模型。
  • 云端声音：填了自己的 Key 时，要读的句子直接发给你选的服务商（OpenAI、微软 Azure 或 ElevenLabs）；读过的声音存在你的设备上。
  • 克隆声音：本机克隆全程在设备上完成、不上传录音；仅在你主动接上自己的 ElevenLabs 账号克隆时，那段录音才会传到你自己的账号。
  • 笔记导出：填了 Notion、flomo 或新枝的令牌或链接时，你发出去的划线直接发给那个服务。
  • 按需模型、声音包与字体：用到有声书对齐、本机离线语音或下载字体时，会从 GitHub Releases 下载对齐模型、离线语音模型、内置声音包和开源字体（Mac 可选的精做层模型从 Hugging Face 下载）；运行全在你的设备上完成，原文与录音不出本机。
  • 应用内反馈（仅在你主动提交时）：你写的反馈、分类、可选的设备与版本信息及公开截图会通过 ntfy.sh（关闭 Firebase 推送）中转为公开的 GitHub Issue；你选择附带的邮箱、日志或私密文件会在发送前用开发者公钥在本机加密。
  • 检查更新（从 GitHub 下载安装的版本，默认开，可在设置里关掉）：每天从 GitHub 取一个小文件，看哪一版最新，不带任何关于你和设备的信息。App Store 和 Google Play 的版本不查，由商店更新。

第三方

语阅里没有任何统计、广告或追踪代码。上面这些请求都从你的设备直接发给你选的服务商，适用它们自己的隐私条款。

Key 和密码

你填的 Key、令牌和密码只存在设备上，不同步、不上传。iPhone 和 iPad 存在钥匙串里，Android 存在由系统密钥库加密的存储里，Mac 存在 App 沙盒文件夹里的一个明文文件中，只有你的用户账号能读。

在设备上完成的

有声书对齐、播客本地转写与语音插话提问时的语音转文字，以及翻译、本机和系统声音朗读、查词，都在你的设备上完成。

保存和删除

开发者手里没有你的任何数据，所以不需要向我们申请删除。在 App 里删掉书或笔记，就从设备上删掉了；删掉 App，它在这台设备上存的东西会全部删除；你自己网盘里的同步文件会一直留着，直到你自己删。

改主意

在设置里关掉同步、移除远程书库或播客订阅，或删掉 Key、令牌，语阅就立刻不再连那个服务。

儿童

语阅不收集任何人的数据，包括儿童。

联系

有问题请写信：yuyue.app@icloud.com

In short Where data lives Network access Keys & passwords On-device Deleting data Contact

In short

Yuyue (语阅) is a free reading and listening app with no servers of its own. It does not collect, store, sell or share any data about you. There are no accounts, no analytics, no tracking and no ads.

Where your data lives

Your books, reading progress, highlights, notes, word lists, podcasts and settings are stored on your own device. If you turn on sync, they travel only between your devices and the storage you choose yourself — iCloud Drive or a WebDAV server (Google Drive coming soon). The developer never receives or sees them.

When the app goes online

Only for things you set up or trigger yourself:

  • Sync with the storage you chose.
  • Remote libraries (OPDS or WebDAV) and podcast feeds (RSS or episode links) you added, fetched straight from their publishers.
  • The reading companion and studio radio with your own API key: your question or reading notes and related passages go directly to the AI provider you picked. Without a cloud key, they use an on-device or local LAN model.
  • Cloud voices with your own key: the sentences to be read go directly to the voice provider you picked (OpenAI, Microsoft Azure or ElevenLabs). Audio already received is kept on your device.
  • Voice cloning with your own ElevenLabs account: the short recording of you reading is kept on your device and sent to that account only when you explicitly clone a voice there; on-device voice cloning never uploads audio.
  • Note export to Notion, flomo or Xinzhi (新枝) with your own token or webhook: the highlights you send go directly to that service.
  • On-demand models, voice packs and fonts: alignment models, offline voice models, the built-in voice pack and optional open-source fonts are downloaded from GitHub Releases (and optional Mac studio voice models from Hugging Face) when you use those features. They run locally on your device; your books and recordings never leave the device.
  • In-app feedback (only when you choose to send it): your message, category, optional device/app info and any public screenshots are sent via ntfy.sh (with Firebase push disabled) and posted as a public GitHub Issue. Any email, logs or private attachments you opt in to include are sealed on your device with the developer's public key before sending.
  • Update checks (versions downloaded from GitHub, on unless you turn it off in Settings): once a day the app reads a small file from GitHub saying which version is newest, sending nothing about you or your device. App Store and Google Play versions don't check; the store updates them.

Third parties

Yuyue contains no analytics, advertising or tracking code. The requests above go from your device straight to the provider you picked; their own privacy terms apply.

Keys and passwords

Keys, tokens and passwords you enter stay on your device and are never synced or uploaded. On iPhone and iPad they are kept in the keychain, on Android in a store encrypted by the system's keystore, and on the Mac in a plain-text file in the app's sandbox folder, readable only by your user account.

On-device features

Speech recognition (for audiobook alignment, local podcast transcription and spoken podcast Q&A), translation, read-aloud with local and system voices and the dictionary all run on your device.

Keeping and deleting your data

Because the developer holds none of your data, there is nothing to request from us. Deleting a book or note in the app removes it from your device. Deleting the app removes everything it stored on that device; files in your own sync storage stay there until you delete them.

Changing your mind

Turn off sync, remove a remote library or podcast feed, or delete a key or token in the app's settings, and Yuyue stops contacting that service right away.

Children

Yuyue collects no data from anyone, including children.

Contact

Questions: yuyue.app@icloud.com
